=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:19802-19815 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: In persist_orch_record_merged_pr(), the `reason=pr_unknown` log branch (`if ! [[ "${porm_pr}" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then`) runs before the STATE_FILE check and the `has("persist_merged_pr")` check. So when an entry already carrying `persist_merged_pr` is revisited with an empty PR, it logs a spurious `PERSIST orch_context outcome=skipped reason=pr_unknown`.
  WHY: The PERSIST log line is contractual (`agents.d/8427-p7-persist-orch-context.md:13`), and the spurious line makes it misleading: operators cannot tell a genuine "PR unknown" from an item that is already recorded. The field and the since-note are unaffected. Both reviewers rated it NIT (mapped to low). anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 raised the same item only as a HARDENING_SUGGESTION and said no current caller reaches it.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: P7 requires the `persist_merged_pr` state field to be recorded when an item flips to merged, so later-wave issue bodies ("Since this plan was decomposed" section, issue #8569 spec) can list earlier merged items with their PR numbers.
  expected_change_site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the backward-scan prior-wave `ai:merged` branches at lines 27622-27633 and 27685-27686, and `persist_orch_record_merged_pr`
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: In the `ai:merged` branch, `_pom_bws_pr` is filled only when `integration_branch` is non-empty and the existing fingerprint lookup succeeds (lines 27624–27633); the last run diff removed the `_subissue_closing_pr_number` elif. With no integration branch, the helper gets an empty PR number and returns without recording the field (lines 19806–19808). The backward scan then excludes that merged item on later ticks (lines 27585–27592), so the since-note permanently renders `PR unknown` (`scripts/persist_orchestrator.py`, lines 187–190). The agents.d fragment documents this as intended behaviour. Severity disagreement: gemini and luna rated it MAJOR, minimax rated it NIT. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rejected this as a task gap: it says plan P7 item 1 (docs/plans/persistent-unattended-workflows-plan.md line 502) covers the current-wave reconcile path, which is implemented at lines 28095-28097 and in the persist loop from line 28290, and that the corner case is a documented, accepted trade-off.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  PROBLEM: The `reason=pr_unknown` log line is written before checking whether the entry already has the field, so an already-recorded entry logs "pr_unknown" even though the since-note shows a PR.
  WHY: The PERSIST orchestrator log output becomes misleading for items that are already persisted correctly.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The `persist_merged_pr` state field must be recorded when an item flips to merged, and later-wave issues must list earlier merged items with their pull request numbers.
  Expected change site: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, the prior-wave backward-scan merge paths.
  Evidence of absence: The backward-scan paths do not guarantee a PR number lookup; they only reuse `PW_PR` from an integration branch or an existing fingerprint capture. Without an integration branch, `persist_merged_pr` is not recorded and the since-note permanently shows "PR unknown".
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
